senses.zh_definition: 芬尼克：外语人名，例如《饥饿游戏》系列中的角色 Finnick Odair；在马来语文本中可作为专有名词使用。
senses.en_definition: A personal name, borne, for example, by Finnick Odair in The Hunger Games series.
senses.ms_definition: Nama khas orang, misalnya Finnick Odair, salah satu watak dalam siri The Hunger Games.
senses.nuances: 本条仅说明可核实的人名用法，不能作为官方马来语普通词条入库。规范书写为 Finnick，首字母大写。马来语释义为编辑撰写，并非 DBP 原文；本次未能核实 DBP 收录情况。音标为该人名的英语读音，参见 [Behind the Name](https://www.behindthename.com/name/finnick)。以下搭配为示范性专名短语，未验证其使用频率；12315 仅为输入排名，不能据此认定马来语词频。

etymology.historical_story: Finnick is documented as a fictional personal name in Suzanne Collins’s Hunger Games series. An interview with Collins identifies Catching Fire as the book in which Finnick and Johanna make their debuts. This establishes a literary context, but does not establish the name’s linguistic derivation or its status as a Malay dictionary word. Its precise etymology remains unverified here. [Author interview hosted by Scholastic](https://mediaroom.scholastic.com/files/Time-Collins-Nov2013.pdf)
